opennyai_summary.decision:
3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Bhubaneswar by order dated 25.05.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. It is submitted that the petitioner is in custody since 15.04.2023 and as charge sheet has been filed on 13.06.2023, further continuance of the petitioner in custody is not warranted.
Considering the tenor thereof and taking into account the filing of charge sheet and period of custody, this Court directs the petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.
9. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
10. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
